## About
Physiotherapy and rehabilitation centre in Doddaballapura, Karnataka, serving patients with movement, pain and recovery needs. We provide personalised physiotherapy care focused on helping patients move with greater comfort, rebuild strength and return to the activities they love.

## Founder and Team
- Founder: Dr. PRAJWAL L NAIK (PT) (MIAP), Owner & Founder
- Team: Dr. BHAVANA R (PT), ARJUN (Nutrition & Dietetics)

## Services
1. Orthopaedic & Pain Rehabilitation
2. Sports Rehabilitation
3. Neurological Rehabilitation
4. Electrotherapy
5. Specialised Care (Paediatric, Geriatric)
6. Home Physiotherapy
7. Post-surgical Rehabilitation
8. Pain Management

Home visit physiotherapy services are available within a 20 km radius of the centre.
